title: Was anyone else obsessed with these aquarium lamps?
content: I remember having the gnarliest recurring dreams while falling asleep to this, including a mall world, fish tank room, airport, and a version of our reality where we are at war. My mom said I was obsessed with it as a child, and she'd have to buy me a new one whenever it broke or I wouldn't be able to fall asleep. I also used to wake up seeing "dark figures" as a kid, and this lamp would help calm me during those episodes.
